premises.text: CheckPoints is a store-agnostic mobile shopping rewards app earning rewards across 1M+ US stores redeemable on-phone
premises.evidence_span: the first shopping rewards application that is store agnostic

premises.text: Advertisers reach targeted demographics in-aisle with product in hand via a virtual end-cap / product interaction page
premises.evidence_span: reach consumers of the demographic they're looking for in any store in America where their product is sold

premises.text: Consumers scan UPCs at featured products to earn points and unlock interactive advertiser content (coupons, social, apps, recipes, surveys)
premises.evidence_span: put it over the UPC code, and it's that simple

premises.text: Coins from scans feed games for more points; points redeem for 40+ partner rewards delivered often in real time on phone
premises.evidence_span: Every time a user scans a featured product, they earn a coin

value.text: Drive in-store product discovery/interaction for advertisers while giving consumers fun extra rewards value
value.evidence_span: allows advertisers to drive discovery and interaction in-store while providing a fun and rewarding opportunity for consumers

causal_links.evidence_span: earn rewards in over one million stores
advertising is reaching the consumer at that most valuable moment

notes: Vantage Media bio excluded (§4.2). Interaction-page content types folded as cascade of one advertiser message surface (§4.1.7). Coins/games/rewards cascade folded into consumer loop.
